Implemented `toggl entry bill [--since <when>] [--until <when>]`.

It filters to stopped, billable entries; rounds every entry up to 15-minute seconds before aggregation; groups unassigned time as `No Project`; sorts totals descending with alphabetical ties; and prints the required project lines plus `Total`, or `(no data)`.

Added command tests in [bill.rs](/home/sandbox/workspace/src/commands/bill.rs:1), plus parser/routing changes in [arguments.rs](/home/sandbox/workspace/src/arguments.rs:167), [main.rs](/home/sandbox/workspace/src/main.rs:256), and [mod.rs](/home/sandbox/workspace/src/commands/mod.rs:4).

Verification: `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy -- -D warnings`, and billing tests pass. Full `cargo test` reached 220 passing tests; one pre-existing auth-status test fails here because the Linux secure keyring is unavailable.

Now `--json`: `{"projects":[{"project":"Alpha","billable_seconds":2700}, ...],"total_billable_seconds":5400}`, projects in the same order as the human output, snake_case keys, integer seconds. In JSON mode stdout is only the JSON document; an empty window is `{"projects":[],"total_billable_seconds":0}`.

Then build and run the existing test suite. (`cargo test` also compiles tests/live_cli.rs, which needs real credentials to actually run — compiling is enough.)
